summary: __thiscall teardown of a linked-list container. Walks the node chain from list head at offset 0x0. For each node with flag byte at node+0xC set and a valid vtable pointer at node+0x0, calls the virtual destructor at vtable slot 0 with the delete flag 1. Every node is freed via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Afterwards zeros list fields at offsets 0x0/0x4/0x8/0xC and returns the last FreeWrapper_7bcf result.

operations.description: For-loop over the node chain seeded from list head at offset 0x0, terminating when the node pointer is zero.
Read node flag byte at node+0xC controlling virtual destruction.
Advance the walk to the next node via the pointer at node+4.
When node flag byte is set and the node vtable pointer (value at node+0x0) is non-zero, invoke virtual destruction.
Call virtual destructor at vtable slot 0 with delete flag 1.
Free each node via FreeWrapper_7bcf; result is carried as the loop result.
Zero list head field at offset 0x0.

unresolved: Identity and object type of the nodes is determined by the vtable at node+0x0, not resolved here.
Semantics of the zeroed list fields 0x4/0x8/0xC beyond container reset are unknown.
